actions.add_faq_item.description: Adds a new question/answer item to an existing FAQ; supports categories.
actions.add_faq_item.props.categories.de: A list of category names. New categories will be created if they do not exist.
actions.add_faq_item.props.faq_id.descri: Select the FAQ to which the item will be added.
actions.add_faq_item.props.source_url.de: An optional URL for the source of the information.
actions.add_video.description: Adds a YouTube video URL as knowledge to the Aidbase knowledge base.
actions.add_video.props.video_url.descri: The URL of the YouTube video to add as a knowledge source.
actions.add_website.description: Adds a website URL as a knowledge source for Aidbase.
actions.add_website.props.website_url.de: The URL of the website to add as a knowledge source (e.g., https://www.example.com).
actions.create_chatbot_reply.description: Generates an AI chatbot reply given a message and optional session context.
actions.create_chatbot_reply.props.chatb: Select the chatbot that will generate the reply.
actions.create_chatbot_reply.props.messa: The message or question to send to the chatbot.
actions.create_chatbot_reply.props.sessi: An optional session ID to maintain conversation context. If omitted, a new conversation will start.
actions.create_faq.description: Creates a new FAQ entry with title and description.
actions.create_faq.props.description.des: An optional description for the FAQ.
actions.create_faq.props.title.descripti: The title of the new FAQ knowledge base.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.start_training.description: Starts a training job on an existing knowledge base item (FAQ, website, video, etc.).
actions.start_training.props.knowledge_i: Select the knowledge item to train.
auth.description:
To get your API Key:
    1. Log in to your Aidbase dashboard.
    2. Navigate to **Settings** in the sidebar.
    3. Click on the **API** section.
    4. Generate and copy your new API Key.
triggers.email_priority_changed.descript: Fires when an email’s priority is changed.
triggers.email_priority_changed.props.in: Select the email inbox to watch. Leave blank to trigger for all inboxes.
triggers.email_priority_changed.props.pr: Select the priority to trigger on. Leave blank to trigger for any priority change.
triggers.email_received.description: Fires when a new email is received in an Aidbase inbox.
triggers.email_received.props.inbox_id.d: Select the email inbox to watch. Leave blank to trigger for all inboxes.
triggers.email_sent.description: Fires when an email is sent from Aidbase.
triggers.email_sent.props.inbox_id.descr: Select the email inbox to watch. Leave blank to trigger for all inboxes.
triggers.email_status_changed.descriptio: Fires when the status of an email changes.
triggers.email_status_changed.props.inbo: Select the email inbox to watch. Leave blank to trigger for all inboxes.
triggers.email_status_changed.props.stat: Select the status to trigger on. Leave blank to trigger for any status change.
triggers.ticket_created.description: Fires when a new ticket is created in Aidbase.
triggers.ticket_created.props.ticket_for: Select the ticket form to watch. Leave blank to trigger for all forms.
triggers.ticket_new_comment.description: Fires when a new comment is added to an existing ticket.
triggers.ticket_new_comment.props.commen: Select the type of commenter to trigger on. Leave blank for all comments.
triggers.ticket_new_comment.props.ticket: Select the ticket form to watch. Leave blank to trigger for all forms.
triggers.ticket_priority_changed.descrip: Fires when the priority of an existing ticket changes.
triggers.ticket_priority_changed.props.p: Select the priority to trigger on. Leave blank to trigger for any priority change.
triggers.ticket_priority_changed.props.t: Select the ticket form to watch. Leave blank to trigger for all forms.
triggers.ticket_status_changed.descripti: Fires when a ticket’s overall status changes.
triggers.ticket_status_changed.props.sta: Select the status to trigger on. Leave blank to trigger for any status change.
triggers.ticket_status_changed.props.tic: Select the ticket form to watch. Leave blank to trigger for all forms.
